description: A small white drawer piece sits to the left, and a larger white box-like bench/drawer unit is on the right in front of the pillow. The left hand slides in from the left and steadies the larger unit by holding its top edge as a left-hand object, while the right hand grips the lower drawer knob as a right-hand object and pulls the drawer straight out toward the right until it comes free and is held away from the box.
